questions.question: How do you want to handle the 11 open tickets before archiving?

options.label: Migrate them to dstrader-docker, then archive (Recommended)
options.description: `gh issue transfer` each open ticket to jdtogni78/dstrader-docker (the daily-driver). GitHub auto-redirects old URLs, so cross-references from FF#36 / dstrader#1 / boards still resolve. Tickets renumber on landing. Then archive dstrader-docker-archive cleanly.

options.label: Archive anyway, accept read-only tickets
options.description: Simpler but locks the tickets. Active work would need new tickets on dstrader-docker. Existing comments + history preserved (read-only).

options.label: Defer archive — close/move tickets organically
options.description: Don't archive now. Let active tickets resolve on dstrader-docker-archive over time; archive once it's empty. Slower but lowest disruption.
